Nordson DAGE 4000 Plus Bond Tester 
The Nordson DAGE 4000Plus is the most advanced solder joint strength tester on the market, offering unparalleled data accuracy and repeatability. Developed by the world's leading company in solder joint testing technology, the Nordson DAGE 4000Plus represents the industry standard in solder joint strength testing. 
Whether in the semiconductor industry or in automotive, power, hybrid, or high-reliability microelectronics sectors, the Nordson DAGE 4000Plus demonstrates versatility and precision, instilling confidence in its users regarding product quality. It incorporates the latest patented solder joint strength testing technologies, such as anti-recoil systems. The test range of the Nordson DAGE 4000Plus is from 250 milligrams to 500 kilograms, suitable for both standard and specialized applications. Notably, the 4000Plus is developed based on the successful Nordson DAGE 4000, ensuring data correlation between the machines.
Features 
• Carrier Tape Tension: Tension tests for all sizes and types of carrier tapes can be conducted using a variety of loading tools, including hooks and jaw tests.
• Hot Pull/Pull Pin Tension: The new test module enhances this pioneering test, particularly useful for evaluating PCB substrate materials and thin copper pillar solder joints.
• Copper Wire First Solder Ball Tension, Chip Tension, Copper Pillar Tension: Custom-made jaws for first-time testing can stretch and test these critical interconnects.
• Fatigue Tension and Shear Force: Fatigue analysis is becoming an increasingly important method for assessing solder joint reliability. The combination of software control and hardware allows for fatigue testing in both tension and shear force modes.
• Passivation Layer Shear Force: The combination of software and specialized pushing blades provides a solution for testing shear forces at constrained locations of the passivation layer.
